name: Moderacja komentarzy
description: Classifies user comments on a Polish news/forum site for moderation, separating blunt but civil criticism from insults, hate speech, spam and self-harm signals.
instructions: Classify this user comment for moderation.

criteria.ok: Acceptable, including strong but civil criticism and disagreement
criteria.insult: Personal attack or insult aimed at a person or group of users
criteria.hate: Hate speech against a protected group (ethnicity, religion, gender, sexuality, disability)
criteria.self_harm: Expresses intent or plans of self-harm or suicide
